## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile/tablet 3D shooter inspired by Polywar with a Call of Duty-style visual direction.

## Requirements
- Support phones and tablets with responsive layout and usable touch controls.
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Created an original first-person objective shooter, “IRON FRONT,” set at Outpost Kilo.
- Used Three.js via CDN, with desktop keyboard/mouse controls and mobile joystick, touch-look, fire, and reload controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the arena, enemies, weapon, HUD, capture objective, combat, scoring, win/loss states, and responsive controls in `index.html`.
- Tested the game in desktop and mobile Chromium: HUD and mobile controls appear, and firing reduces ammo from 30 to 29.
- Adjusted mobile layout to move the ammo display above the touch controls.
- Updated game start to reset reserve ammo display to 180.
- Captured desktop and mobile screenshots in `/tmp/opencode/ironfront-final/`.

### Active
- Verify reload and ammo replenishment after recent layout/UI changes; the reload test did not complete during the observation window.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Retest reload with enough time for game frames to advance; mobile rendering was slow in the test environment.
2. Recheck desktop and mobile gameplay and console output after the latest edits.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; recent mobile layout and ammo reset edits.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `index.html` and other project files are untracked.
- Capture run with `CAPTURE_STRICT=1` succeeded. Gameplay tests logged no page errors, but console reported resource 404s; earlier testing identified a missing `/favicon.ico`.
- A mobile Playwright timing check took about 544 ms for three animation frames; reload had not completed after 2.5 seconds of wall time, so reload behavior remains unverified.
